verdict.rationale: Official docs say Logseq Sync syncs up to 10 graphs across Desktop, Android and iOS, and state that the graph is end-to-end encrypted. Hands-on community reports add significant caveats: sync was sponsor-gated while in testing and had enough bugs that one user wouldn't rely on it, and another says early sync attempts didn't work well. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that sync is stable and reliable, detail on the encryption model showing the vendor cannot read data (key management, zero-knowledge design), and current availability/pricing clarity.
